name: binance
label: Binance
description: Get public Binance spot market data: prices, 24h statistics, order book, recent trades, candles and trading pairs. No API key needed.

fetch_crypto_pair_price.label: Fetch Pair Price
fetch_crypto_pair_price.description: Fetch the current price of a pair (e.g. BTC/USDT)

first_coin.label: First Coin Symbol
first_coin.description: The currency to fetch the price for (e.g. 'BTC' in 'BTC/USDT')

second_coin.label: Second Coin Symbol
second_coin.description: The currency to fetch the price in (e.g. 'USDT' in 'BTC/USDT')

binance_get_price.label: Get Price
binance_get_price.description: Get the latest trade price of one Binance spot trading pair.

symbol.label: Symbol
symbol.description: The trading pair: base asset followed by quote asset, for example BTCUSDT or ETHBTC. Spaces and '/' are removed and letters are upper-cased, so 'btc/usdt' also works. Use List Trading Pairs to find a symbol.

get_24h_ticker.label: Get 24h Ticker Stats
get_24h_ticker.description: Get 24-hour price change, high, low, volume and best bid/ask for a Binance spot trading pair.

symbol.label: Symbol
symbol.description: The trading pair: base asset followed by quote asset, for example BTCUSDT or ETHBTC. Spaces and '/' are removed and letters are upper-cased, so 'btc/usdt' also works. Use List Trading Pairs to find a symbol.

type.label: Detail Level
type.description: Full (default) adds price change and percent, weighted average price, previous close, last quantity and best bid/ask. Mini returns only open, high, low and last price, volumes and trade count.

get_trading_pair_rules.label: Get Trading Pair Rules
get_trading_pair_rules.description: Get the trading rules of a Binance spot pair: status, tick size, quantity step, minimum and maximum order size and value.
